diagnosis: The view searches DiscoveryDocument using metadata__has_key based on an untrusted query parameter without scoping the queryset to the legal matter or law firm associated with request.user. Attorneys can discover privileged litigation documents, confidential settlement tags, and opposing counsel draft work product from other law firms.
exploit_request:
GET /api/litigation/discovery/filter-by-key/?meta_key=settlement_concession HTTP/1.1
Host: litigation.ediscovery-hub.com
Authorization: Bearer <opposing_counsel_token>
